finding.title: Buffer Overflow
finding.trigger: Sending more than 258 bytes of data to the server
finding.assumptions: The buffer size is fixed at 258 bytes, and the received data is directly printed without any checks.

parsed.refutation_attempt: Checked for a size or range verification before the memcpy, strcpy, or array access. Found that the buffer size is fixed at 258 bytes and the received data is directly printed without any checks. However, the code uses a loop to print each byte individually, which prevents a buffer overflow from occurring.

finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: Sending a crafted input that includes shell metacharacters
finding.assumptions: The input is directly sent to the client without any validation or sanitization.

parsed.refutation_attempt: The code does not execute any shell commands. The input from stdin is directly sent to the client using the sendto function without any shell execution. The input is only validated by removing the newline character, but there is no indication of shell command execution.
